response: "When FBI operative Rachel Jenkins is sent back in time to 1962, she finds herself in the midst of a decades-old serial killer case. The notorious 'Timekeeper' has been leaving a trail of bodies across the country, and Rachel's unique knowledge of future forensic techniques is the only hope for catching him. As she navigates the unfamiliar world of 1960s America, Rachel must use her skills to leave subtle clues that will aid her modern colleagues in tracking down the killer. With the Timekeeper's next victim already in his sights, Rachel must work against the clock to prevent a catastrophic future. Can she outsmart the killer and find a way back to her own time, or will she become the Timekeeper's next victim? 1. The year is 1962. 2. The case is 50 years old. 3. Rachel's knowledge of future forensics is her only hope. 4. The Timekeeper's next victim is a young woman named Sarah. 5. Rachel's first clue is a torn piece of fabric caught in a 6. old-fashioned typewriter. 7. The typewriter is found in a 8. abandoned warehouse on the outskirts of town. 9. Rachel's next clue is a 10. cryptic message scrawled on a 11. bathroom wall. 12. The message reads: "The clock is ticking." 13. Can Rachel solve the case before it's too late?"
